services.name: Fishing Report
services.desc: Terry’s Boat Harbor is very involved on Lake Mille Lacs. We offer a fishing, lake, ice report to give you the latest update about all things Lake Mille Lacs. Our report informs you about the conditions of the lake, fishing reports, ice conditions, and ice road reports. We have spent over 45 years fishing on Mille Lacs Lake and want to share our knowledge of the lake with you. Want to find out if the fish are biting? Utilize Terry’s Boat Harbor’s fishing report for the latest update of the fishing on Mille Lacs Lake. We’ll let you know where the walleye are biting, the bass, and every other fish on beautiful Lake Mille Lacs. We know that you don’t want to come up empty-handed on your fishing

services.desc: Before you head out to chase the legendary walleye of Mille Lacs Lake, make a pit stop at Terry’s Boat Harbor. Our fully stocked bait and tackle shop is designed to be the ultimate convenience hub for anglers and recreational boaters alike. We understand that success on the water starts with the right equipment, which is why we carry a premium selection of live bait, including the local favorites: night crawlers, leeches, and minnows. Beyond bait, we provide a curated range of terminal fishing tackle, snacks, and cold beverages to keep you fueled for a full day on the waves. One of the most critical services we provide is our commercial fueling dock, exclusively offering ethanol-free boat

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Enjoy fishing Mille Lacs and other Lakes and Rivers with a private guide. At Terry’s, we will help you arrange a private guide trip with the following guides. Hall of Famers “Mr. Walleye” Gary Roach, Dick the “Griz” Grizywinski. “Dialed in Angling’s” Tony Roach. Pat Burch. Tim Ajax and Ryan Kelly Lagoona Guide service. Whether you’re a seasoned angler or just getting started, hiring a private guide can make all the difference between a good day on the water and a truly unforgettable one. Our guides bring years of local knowledge, professional-grade equipment, and a passion for putting you on fish - so you can focus on the experience and let them handle the rest.
